name: Motif ~Sepia-iro no Sobyou~
source:
Shinya Kano opposed his father's will and for three months he needs to support himself. As he arrives home for the first time in four years he finds three smiling girls who call themselves "sisters" even though there should have been no one there.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
